\documentclass{article}
\title{Scaling the Sequence Encoder}
\date{2024}
\begin{document}
\begin{abstract}
We study how the encoder behaves at larger scale.
\end{abstract}

\section{Setup}
We report two configurations. For the base model we use a learning rate of
0.0001, matching earlier work. For the large model we use a learning rate of
0.00005 instead, since the larger stack is less stable.

We keep a dropout rate of 0.1 for the base model throughout.

\end{document}
